title: Planet Puar: talented Music star drops new Track "No Vest Freestyle"
htmlContent:
American-based hip-hop artist Planet Puar is a multi-talented rapper and a lyrical genius climbing his way up to the top. He has once again proven his worth in the music industry with the release of his recent track "No vest freestyle."

Planet Puar's "No vest freestyle" is an excellent proportion of rapping with authority, as you can hear the trust in his meter and his voice at a genius level that connects to his listener's heart. On this track, Planet Puar surveys his sound and finds himself musically, and he is determined to make a name for himself in this harsh industry.
